question: Should omitting Active Memory `config.agents` remain explicit opt-in, fall back only to implicit `main`, or activate every configured agent?
rationale: Current main contains an inconsistency, but the PR chooses the broadest resolution and changes a shipped configuration default with recall and session-state consequences.

options.title: Preserve explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep omission non-activating and repair the command/runtime inconsistency without automatically targeting additional agents.

options.title: Fallback only to main
options.body: Adopt the narrow default-agent behavior needed by the linked single-agent reproduction while preserving explicit empty as no targets.

options.title: Activate configured agents
options.body: Accept automatic multi-agent activation with clear upgrade communication and direct final-head proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep omission non-activating and repair the command/runtime inconsistency without automatically targeting additional agents.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history identifies Tak Hoffman as the primary contributor across the Active Memory implementation, tests, configuration, and docs.
